parties.petitioner: The General Manager Personnel, Syndicate Bank & Ors

summary: Disciplinary dismissal for financial misconduct; fictitious debits, SKCC fraud, misappropriation; admissions and recovery of funds; prior closure of vigilance issue disputed; adequacy of evidence threshold in departmental proceedings; natural justice; criminal acquittal irrelevant; High Court interference on 'no evidence' ground; concurrent findings; documentary evidence and admissions; standard of 'some evidence'; reliance on B.C. Chaturvedi and RBI Manager precedents; penalty of dismissal upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Syndicate Bank Officer Employees’ (Conduct) Regulations 1976, Regulation 3(1), Regulation 24
Article 226 of the Constitution of India
B.C. Chaturvedi v. Union of India and Others
Manager, Reserve Bank of India, Bangalore v. S. Mani and Others
State Bank of India and Others v. Ramesh Dinkar Punde
Indian Airlines Limited v. Prabha D. Kanan
Roop Singh Negi v. Punjab National Bank and Others
Pravin Kumar v. Union of India and Others
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment of High Court set aside; orders of Disciplinary Authority and Appellate Authority restoring dismissal reinstated.
